definitions.gloss: to be in full bloom, to bloom magnificently
definitions.explanation: To bloom in full glory, with flowers at the peak of their beauty. Conveys a sense of splendor and abundance in blooming.

examples.japanese: ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{咲|さ}き{誇|ほこ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The cherry blossoms are in full bloom.

examples.japanese: ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧バラ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しく→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧{咲|さ}き{誇|ほこ}って⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The roses in the garden were blooming magnificently.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花壇|かだん}→花壇：11075_kadan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{色|いろ}とりどり→色とりどり：10404_irotoridori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{咲|さ}き{誇|ほこ}る。
examples.english: When spring comes, colorful flowers bloom in full glory in the park's flower beds.

notes:
Godan verb (る row: {咲|さ}き{誇|ほこ}る → {咲|さ}き{誇|ほこ}らない → {咲|さ}き{誇|ほこ}って). A compound of ⟦{咲|さ}く→咲く：08150_saku⟧ (to bloom) + ⟦{誇|ほこ}る→誇る：14180_hokoru⟧ (to boast/be proud), suggesting flowers blooming so splendidly they seem to boast. Often used in literary and poetic descriptions of nature.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{咲|さ}き{誇|ほこ}る — cherry blossoms in full bloom
- ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{咲|さ}き{誇|ほこ}る — flowers in full bloom
- ⟦{一面|いちめん}→一面：11184_ichimen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{咲|さ}き{誇|ほこ}る — to bloom across an entire area
